descriptionHtml:
‘TRIERVIEW 2.0’ is a series of virtual interviews organized for the final year and third year undergraduates of the Electrical and Electronic Engineering Department and Computer Engineering Department where they get the chance to face a proper interview with the most prominent companies in the relevant fields such as Ceylon Electricity Board, Dialog Axiata PLC, SLT, Synopsys. This event is planned to improve the skills of the undergraduates of the faculty to face an interview in a better way.

Interviewers :

Mr. Ashan Imantha M.H. Bandara (Electrical Engineer, Asset Management and Condition Monitoring Branch, Transmission Division, CEB)

Ms. Dulma Ireshani (Application Engineer, Synopsis Lanka (Pvt) Ltd)

Ms. Heshani Mahalaksha (Electrical Engineer, CEB)

Mr. Rajiv Weragama (Engineer, SLT)

Mr. Ravishan Silva (Senior Executive, Human Resources, Dialog Axiata PLC)

Mr. Thejan Ariyarathna (Engineer, Dialog Axiata PLC)

Ms. Vimukthi Perera (Associate Technical Lead SRE - WSO2)
